meta.name: Charlie Chopra & The Mystery of Solang Valley
meta.description: Amateur detective Charlie Chopra investigates a murder at her fiancé's family home in the mountains of Himachal Pradesh, uncovering secrets and facing danger.

videos.title: The Legend of Lady Rose
videos.overview: When her fiancé is implicated as the prime suspect in a murder, Charulata 'Charlie' Chopra rushes to his family home in Solang Valley to uncover the mysteries around this death and the secrets of this sleepy hill town.

videos.title: Sansani
videos.overview: After the explosive arrival of Nikki leaves the entire family reeling, Charlie begins to dig into their secrets, aided by a reluctant partnership with Sitaram.

videos.title: Keh Do Ki Ye Jhooth Hai
videos.overview: When Solang Valley is rocked by a second death in a matter of weeks, Charlie’s investigation kicks into an overdrive, as she reopens questions that others thought were already answered.

videos.title: Organic Honey
videos.overview: After a personal betrayal, Charlie becomes obsessed with unearthing the truth no matter the cost, but her reckless pursuit gives way to more enemies than answers.

videos.title: Main Phuddu Aan
videos.overview: Narrowly escaping a close call with death, Charlie reunites with Sitaram. Together they race against time to find the murderer, because now they’re next on the list.

videos.title: Look Within
videos.overview: More lives are lost, secrets unearthed, and betrayals come to light in the final chapter of Charlie’s investigation.
